The law: If injuries not reaching light injury, still considered "故意伤害罪" but maybe "轻伤" threshold. If no injury, maybe "故意伤害罪" still if there is bodily harm? The victim had multiple soft tissue injuries, concussion, scalp contusion, but not reaching light injury. That may be considered "轻伤" threshold? They forced him to write receipt and cancel commission, maybe to get money? The description: "强迫被害人写下相关收款收据和委托书作废的字据". That suggests they forced victim to sign receipts acknowledging payment and cancel commission. That is extortion (敲诈勒索) or "非法拘禁" used to force victim to sign documents, which is a form of extortion.
